heading: INT. GRAIN ELEVATOR, NIGHT SHIFT - NIGHT

units.text: INT. GRAIN ELEVATOR, NIGHT SHIFT - NIGHT
A cathedral of concrete silos.
Dust hangs in the lamplight like pollen.
Belts clank.
Somewhere deep in the dark, grain pours with a sound like breathing.
ODELIA FINCH, 30s, hard hat, headlamp, clipboard, stands on a steel catwalk twenty feet up.
Below her, BIG ROY MALLORY, 50s, bearded, sleeves rolled, rakes a heap of wheat from a hopper.
And in the doorway of the control shed, DESMOND "DEZ" PARRISH, 20s, a new hire, grips a thermos like a rosary.
Roy, bin four is reading empty.
units.name: ODELIA

units.text: Bin four's full. I filled it myself at six.
units.name: BIG ROY

units.text: The gauge says empty.
units.name: ODELIA

units.text: Gauge is lying.
units.name: BIG ROY

units.text: Miss Finch, I heard something in four.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: What kind of something, Dez?
units.name: ODELIA

units.text: A knocking.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: It's the wheat settling, kid.
units.name: BIG ROY

units.text: It was knocking back.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Silence.
The grain pours in the dark.
Odelia's headlamp swings across the silo hatch.
Big Roy leans on the rake and does not smile.
Odelia. Don't open the hatch.
units.name: BIG ROY

units.text: Roy, why not?
units.name: ODELIA

units.text: Because I didn't fill it at six.
units.name: BIG ROY

units.text: He sets the rake against the hopper.
His hands are shaking.
Odelia climbs down the ladder, rung by rung, and crosses to the hatch.
Miss Finch. Please.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Dez, go home.
units.name: ODELIA

units.text: The truck's at the other end of the lot.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Then run.
units.name: ODELIA

units.text: He doesn't.
Odelia grips the wheel on the hatch.
From inside the silo comes three slow knocks.
She drops her hand.
Big Roy lets out a breath that is half a sob.
It's been knocking since June.
units.name: BIG ROY

units.text: Why didn't you say?
units.name: ODELIA

units.text: Because nobody asked it what it wanted.
units.name: BIG ROY

units.text: The hatch wheel turns on its own.
Slowly.
One quarter turn.
The headlamp flickers and goes out.
